title: hoa_banned_my_parkour_course
beats: My HOA president told me my backyard obstacle course was 'attracting the wrong element' -- he meant kids having fun.
He gave me 48 hours to tear it down or face a $500 daily fine.
I noticed the fine clause never said what counted as 'the course.'
So I tore down the wooden ramps, exactly as ordered.
Then I replaced them with something the HOA rulebook never mentioned: parkour-grade concrete platforms, permanently poured, disguised as 'landscaping features.'
Landscaping was explicitly protected under the HOA's own beautification bylaw -- he'd written it himself.
He tried to fine me anyway, and I brought that bylaw to the emergency meeting.
The board voted against him, unanimously, in his own kitchen.
The course is still there. Kids still play. He resigned two months later.
